name: Aragaki Satoshi
source:
Chiyoko's husband. He married her out of convenience. He routinely takes her paychecks so that he can spend it on other women. He considers his wife and son to be burdens.

When he's not with other women, he forcibly has sex with Chiyoko against her will at work.
